description: Lists what a domain costs at Spaicely per extension: registering, renewing and moving it to Spaicely, each for its whole term (months, paid up front) and per year. We sell 718 extensions. Pass extensions for those only, or filter: kind country or generic, max_per_year (whole euros, pounds or dollars; neither registering nor renewing costs more per year), sort by name, register or renew. Without extensions at most 100 come per call; total says how many match and offset pages on. Prices are before VAT, in currency (eur, gbp or usd); pass country (two letters) for that country's currency and the price a consumer there pays with VAT. A business pays before VAT. A transfer with months null adds no term and often costs nothing. Premium names cost more: domains.search says so per name. Needs no account.

country.description: The person's country, two letters (NL, DE, GB, US): its currency and VAT.

currency.description: eur, gbp or usd. Default: the currency of country, else eur.

extensions.description: Extensions such as nl, com, co.uk. Default: all, a page at a time.

max_per_year.description: Only extensions that cost at most this per year, in currency.

offset.description: Skip this many, to page on.

sort.description: name (default), register or renew: cheapest first.

name: domains.prices
title: List domain prices per extension
